assumptions: The capacity field of each string is the qword at its +0x10 slot; the binary reads that slot only as the sized-delete size (plus one) and never as a pointer.
The model treats a chain as a Python list of nodes; the binary walks a singly linked list through node +0x10.

tail_jump_site.note: the caller adds 0x10 to its own argument before jumping, so the routine receives an object pointer 0x10 past the caller's argument

exits.form: tail jump to the sized-delete PLT at 0x63f0d80 from 0x5d503eb

per_node.step: sized delete of the node itself

string.short_form_condition: data pointer equals the address of the capacity field

unknowns: What the callee at 0x5d4cfd0 computes for the value at node +0x18; pinned by call shape only.
The source-level names of the object, the chain nodes and the string fields.
Whether either chain can be cyclic in a well-formed object; the binary keeps no visited set, so a cyclic chain would loop forever in the binary as in the model.
